title: Clinic user can sign in and reach clinic portal
description: Verifies a clinic user can sign in from the authentication page and is routed into the clinic portal shell successfully.

steps.description: Verify the clinic portal shell is displayed

title: Hospital user can sign in and reach hospital portal
description: Verifies a hospital user can sign in and is routed into the hospital portal shell successfully.

steps.description: Verify the hospital portal shell is displayed

title: Admin user can sign in and reach admin portal
description: Verifies an admin user can sign in and is routed into the admin portal shell successfully.

steps.description: Verify the admin portal shell is displayed

title: Clinic user can create a referral and see it in referral list
description: Verifies a clinic user can create a new referral from the referral form and then see the referral appear in the clinic referrals list.

steps.description: Click the link to view clinic referrals
Click the action to start creating a new referral
Fill out the referral form with valid values
Verify the clinic referrals list shows the newly created referral

title: Hospital staff can assign an inbox referral and see it in assigned cases
description: Verifies a hospital user can open an inbox referral, assign it to themselves or a teammate, and then see it listed in assigned cases.

steps.description: Click the link to open the hospital inbox
Open the first available referral in the inbox list
Click the link to view assigned cases
Verify the assigned cases list includes the case that was just assigned

title: Approve a pending user and see them in the users list
description: Verifies an admin can approve a pending user and the user then appears in the users list.

steps.description: Click to open the approvals module
Approve the first pending user in the list
Click to open the users module
Verify the approved user appears in the users list

title: Clinic user can view referral detail and send a message update
description: Verifies a clinic user can open a referral from the list, then send a message update that appears in the conversation thread.

steps.description: Click the link to view clinic referrals
Click the action to start creating a new referral
Fill out the referral form with valid values
Click the newly created referral in the referrals list
Click the link to open clinic messages
Fill Clinic update message 001 into the message composer
Verify the conversation thread displays Clinic update message 001

title: Change a role’s permissions and see an audit entry
description: Verifies an admin can update role permissions and the change is recorded in the audit log.

steps.description: Click to open the roles module
Change at least one permission setting
Click to open the audit module
Verify a recent audit entry reflects the role or permission change

title: Hospital staff can provide feedback and message the clinic
description: Verifies a hospital user can select a case in the feedback center, save feedback, and then send a message to the clinic about the feedback.

steps.description: Click the link to open the feedback center
Select a case to provide feedback
Fill Feedback note 001 into the feedback field
Click the link to open hospital messages
Fill Feedback note 001 into the message composer
Verify the conversation thread displays Feedback note 001

title: View admin dashboard modules from the admin portal shell
description: Verifies an admin can access the admin portal and see navigation to core governance modules.

steps.description: Click to open the admin portal
Verify the admin dashboard shows navigation entries for approvals, users, roles, and audit

title: Update a clinic record and verify hospitals module is accessible after
description: Verifies an admin can edit and save a clinic record and then access the hospitals module successfully.

steps.description: Click to open the clinics module
Open the first clinic record from the list
Update a clinic metadata field with a new value
Click to open the hospitals module
Verify the hospitals list is displayed

title: Users list supports basic search/filtering to find a user
description: Verifies an admin can use on-page filtering or search to narrow the users list.

steps.description: Click to open the users module
Fill a partial identifier into the user search or filter field
Wait for the list to update
Verify the users list is narrowed to matching results

title: Invalid credentials are rejected
description: Verifies that submitting the sign-in form with an incorrect password shows an invalid-credentials error and does not sign the user in.

steps.description: Fill invalid-user@example.com into the identifier field
Fill wrong-password into the password field
Verify an invalid credentials error is visible

title: Referral form enforces required fields
description: Verifies that attempting to submit a new referral with required fields missing shows inline validation errors and does not create the referral.

steps.description: Click the action to start creating a new referral
Verify required-field validation errors are visible on the referral form

title: Role editing requires saving before changes take effect in the UI
description: Verifies unsaved role changes are not persisted until the admin saves and the UI reflects the saved state.

steps.description: Click to open the roles module
Change at least one permission setting
Navigate away by clicking to open the users module
Verify the role editor does not show the unsaved permission change as applied

title: Approvals queue supports empty state without breaking navigation
description: Verifies the approvals page handles no pending users by showing an empty state and remains usable.

steps.description: Click to open the approvals module
Wait for the approvals list to finish loading
Verify either a list of pending users is displayed or an empty state message is visible
Click to open the users module
Verify the users list is displayed

title: Password visibility toggle changes password masking
description: Verifies the password visibility control toggles the password field between masked and unmasked states.

steps.description: Fill demo-password-123 into the password field
Verify the password value is visible in the password field
